name: Zul'Gurub: Venoxis's Parasitic Serpents run as fast as his Razzashi Cobras
contract: The testers of 2026-11-13 report that the Parasitic Serpents (14884) of High Priest Venoxis "still move too
slowly". Their template ran at 0.571429 (4 yards per second), the Razzashi Cobra (11373) at 1.14286
(8 yards per second). The user approved the cobra's speed on 2026-11-13 as an estimate for all four
difficulty templates (14884, 114884, 214884, 314884); no live source gives the serpent's own speed. A
serpent summoned in a Mythic Zul'Gurub takes the Mythic template, and its native run speed rate must be the

steps.label: CONTROL: the hero is in Zul'Gurub
CONTROL: the serpent takes the Mythic template
DISCRIMINATING: the serpent runs at the cobra's 1.14286 (8 yards per second)
